description: Implement Tailwind v4 CSS compilation in C. A JIT-style class scanner that scans .khtml, .c, and .h files for Tailwind class names, then emits the corresponding CSS. No Node.js required. Covers the most commonly used Tailwind utility classes.
steps: Create src/kern_tailwind.c implementing the Tailwind CSS compiler: (a) kern_tw_scan_file(path) - scans a file for class name tokens (splits by whitespace, quotes, template delimiters), (b) kern_tw_scan_dir(path, recursive) - scans all .khtml/.c/.h files, (c) kern_tw_compile(class_list) - given a list of detected class names, emits the corresponding CSS rules. Supports: spacing (p-*, m-*, gap-*), sizing (w-*, h-*, min-w-*, max-w-*), typography (text-*, font-*, leading-*, tracking-*), colors (bg-*, text-*, border-* with zinc/red/green/blue/yellow/purple/pink/gray palettes), borders (border, rounded-*), flexbox (flex, flex-row, flex-col, items-*, justify-*, flex-1, flex-auto, flex-none, grow, shrink), grid (grid, grid-cols-*, col-span-*), display (block, inline, inline-block, hidden, flex, grid), position (relative, absolute, fixed, sticky, top-*, left-*, right-*, bottom-*), overflow (overflow-*), opacity (opacity-*), transitions (transition, duration-*, ease-*), responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:), hover/focus/active state prefixes (hover:, focus:, active:, disabled:).
Add Tailwind API to include/kern.h: kern_tw_scan_file(), kern_tw_scan_dir(), kern_tw_compile(), kern_tw_compile_to_file(output_path).
Integrate Tailwind compilation into cli/cmd_build.c: after asset processing, scan project files for classes and emit compiled CSS to the output CSS file.
Add src/kern_tailwind.c to CMakeLists.txt library sources.

Create tests/test_tailwind.c testing: class scanning from a string (detecting 'flex items-center p-4' etc.), CSS emission for known classes (p-4 => padding: 1rem, flex => display: flex), responsive prefix handling (md:flex => @media (min-width: 768px) { .md\:flex { display: flex } }), state variant handling (hover:bg-zinc-100 => .hover\:bg-zinc-100:hover { background-color: ... }).
Add test_tailwind to KERN_TESTS in CMakeLists.txt.
acceptance_criteria: kern_tw_scan_file correctly extracts class names from .khtml and .c content
kern_tw_compile generates valid CSS for spacing, color, flexbox, typography, and layout utilities
State variants (hover:, focus:) generate correct pseudo-class selectors
Generated CSS is deterministic (sorted by utility category)
findings: All 25 tests pass (24 existing + 1 new test_tailwind with 13 assertions). Build is clean with -Wall -Wextra -pedantic. The emit_selector function uses single-backslash CSS escaping for colons in class names (e.g., hover\:bg-zinc-100). The spacing format uses %.2g for clean output (1rem not 1.00rem). Color palette uses Tailwind v4 hex values.
